name: Flickering Flames in Kalimdor
label: Quest
description: Flickering Flames in Kalimdor: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There are many flames burning throughout the world today, friend. The trickiest fires to tend are those that burn green; they do not stay lit long without supervision. Make certain the emerald fires still burn on Kalimdor for our Flamekeeper, eh?

You will find them near Ratchet in the Barrens, close to the Master's Glaive in Darkshore, in the forest of Ashenvale by the bridge near Silverwing Outpost, and near the road to Windshear Crag along the main road in Stonetalon Mountains.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The fires cannot die until the festival is done!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ahhh, so they do still burn. I am glad; it would not do for those fires to burn out before their time. You have done well, friend. Take this with my blessing.
